voiceoverSegments.line: We start by loading the last thousand candles of price history, the foundation every strategy needs.
Next we add a 9‑period EMA, giving more weight to recent prices for a fast trend line.
Then we layer a 21‑period EMA, a slower average that smooths out short‑term noise.
We plot the fast EMA in a bright blue line so its movement is easy to see.
We plot the slow EMA in the same bright blue, keeping the visual style consistent.
A crossover node fires whenever the fast EMA moves above the slow EMA, signalling a bullish trigger.
A crossunder node triggers when the fast EMA falls below the slow EMA, marking a bearish signal.
We then run the strategy through a full backtest engine, generating a detailed trade ledger.
Finally we overlay the trades on the chart, showing entry and exit markers for review.

outro.voiceover: On the chart you now see the fast and slow EMAs plotted, crossover signals highlighted, and trade overlays displayed, ready to backtest.
